subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing & committed-use options (startup program)
summary: Post-demo follow-up to confirm token volumes, target unit economics ($/1M tokens), and next steps for startup discount vs committed-use pricing. Proposed next step: contract draft and PO with Ben for legal/finance review.
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@acmeai.com>
Cc: Sara Kim <sara@acmeai.com>
Date: 2026-07-28T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: pricing & committed-use options (startup program)

Hi Daniel / Sara,

Thanks again for the demo today — really enjoyed seeing the Acme AI use case for multi-agent orchestration. Per our conversation, I wanted to capture the rough volumes and pricing targets so we can align on the right offer (startup credits vs committed use).

Quick summary of what I heard:
- Current pilot: ~1.5B tokens/month (mainly text-gen + embeddings)
- Expected ramp: 1.5B -> ~5B tokens/month within 9-12 months as usage expands to production workflows
- Target unit economics: roughly $400–$600 per 1M tokens (budget range CFO indicated)

Options we discussed:
1) Startup program (one-time credits + onboarding discount): good for early-stage pilots; typically includes $50k of credits + 25–30% discount for the first 6 months.
2) Committed-use (monthly/annual commit): deeper discounts (tiered) based on committed volume and term (12–36 months); multi-year commitments can unlock additional 10–20% off the baseline committed rate.

Attachments: I attached the Redwood-Startup-Program-Terms.pdf and a quick worksheet for committing volumes.

Can you confirm the following so I can put together an apples-to-apples pricing comparison?
- Confirm expected average monthly tokens over the next 12 months (you can use ballpark; we can iterate)
- Your target $/1M tokens (you mentioned $400–$600; is there a firm internal target?)
- Any procurement timing constraints (PO/contract sign-by date)?

Next steps I propose: I’ll run two scenarios (startup credit + 6mo discount) vs committed use (12mo and 24mo tiers) and share a short pricing memo. If that looks good, I’ll loop Ben (AE) to start the contract/PO conversation and send a draft SOW.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

On Tue, Jul 28, 2026 at 15:00 Daniel Park <daniel@acmeai.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the call — great overview.
>
> — Daniel

From: Daniel Park <daniel@acmeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Kim <sara@acmeai.com>
Date: 2026-07-30T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing & committed-use options (startup program)

Marissa,

Appreciate the summary. A few clarifications from our side:
- Confirming pilot numbers: current pilot is ~1.5B tokens/month; our product team expects this to reach ~3B in 3–4 months and ~5B within 9–12 months if the service performs as expected.
- Budget/target: Sara (CFO) has indicated an internal target of ~$450 per 1M tokens but we can stretch to $375 if there is a multi-year commitment and better support/SLAs.
- Procurement timing: we’d like to have commercial terms in place before end of Q3 (target sign-by 2026-09-30) to align with our internal budgeting.

Questions for you:
1) For committed-use, what would the ballpark $/1M look like for a 12mo vs 24mo commitment at a 3B baseline? If you can provide a simple table, that would help our CFO.
2) For the startup program, can you confirm the exact credit amount and whether that counts against committed volume if we convert to a commit within the first 6 months?

If easier, happy to hop on a short call with Ben to speed up procurement questions.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director of Product | Acme AI
daniel@acmeai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@acmeai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Sara Kim <sara@acmeai.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing & committed-use options (startup program)

Thanks Daniel — helpful context. I put together the two scenarios below (high level) and attached a short worksheet with the math.

Scenario A — Startup Program (best for early ramp / pilot)
- One-time credits: $50k in credits applied to usage over the first 6 months.
- Discount: 30% off list for first 6 months (applies to overage after credits).
- Conversion: if you convert to a committed use within the first 6 months, credits are not applied against committed volume; they act as an onboarding offset only.

Scenario B — Committed Use (recommended for predictable unit economics)
Assumptions: baseline 3B tokens/month average for year 1.
- 12-month commit: baseline price ~$520 per 1M tokens, with tiered pricing that brings effective cost to ~ $420–$470 per 1M at higher tiers (>=4B).
- 24-month commit: baseline price ~$470 per 1M tokens, effective cost to ~ $375–$420 per 1M at higher tiers and with a 5% multi-year incentive applied.
- Multi-year: we can explore an additional 5–10% incentive tied to a signed 24–36 month agreement and a modest revenue protection clause.

Next steps:
- I’ll produce a short two-sheet pricing memo (startup vs commit: line items, effective $/1M, and run-rate impact).
- If those numbers look close to your target ($375–$450), Ben will pick up the contracting and procurement conversation (POs, SOW, invoice cadence).

Ben — looping you here to help with contractual timelines and PO process. Ben, Acme is targeting sign-by 2026-09-30 and is interested in exploring a 24-month commit if the effective $/1M can get into the $375–$420 range.

Daniel / Sara — is Sep 30 a hard deadline or a target? If target, we’ll prioritize the 24-month pricing + draft term sheet for review.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

--
Marissa Cole
Redwood Inference
